name: Szárász (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and tan at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Szárász (a green shield with a red monogram and a castle) within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed SZÁRÁSZ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szárász arms with wreath and scroll
